title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to attend Deepotsav 2026 in Ayodhya on November 7
body_text: The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Ayodhya on November 7, 2026, to participate in Deepotsav 2026. During his visit, the Vice-President will offer prayers at the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple and participate in the symbolic coronation ceremony of Prabhu Shri Ram in Ayodhya. He will also felicitate revered saints on the occasion. *** PR/ASM/VM
